mapper.select: select a.rank_id,a.rank_name,a.vote_count,a.love_count,a.publish_time, b.rs_id,b.song_id,b.ranking,b.rank_update_time,c.song_name,d.singer_name,u.username from (select p.rank_id,p.rank_name,p.publish_time,p.user_id,coalesce(v.total_vote,0) as vote_count,coalesce(l.total_love,0) as love_count from personal_rank as p left join (select rank_id,count(*) as total_vote from vote_record group by rank_id) as v on v.rank_id=p.rank_id left join (select rank_id,count(*) as total_love from love_record group by rank_id) as l on l.rank_id=p.rank_id where p.user_id=#{userId} group by p.rank_id, p.rank_name, p.publish_time order by publish_time asc limit #{pageSize} offset #{offset}) a left join rank_song as b on a.rank_id = b.rank_id left join song as c on c.song_id=b.song_id left join singer as d on c.singer_id = d.singer_id left join user u on u.user_id=a.user_id order by b.rank_update_time desc, b.ranking asc

select a.rank_id,a.rank_name,b.rs_id,b.song_id,b.ranking,b.rank_update_time ,c.song_name from personal_rank as a left join rank_song as b on a.rank_id = b.rank_id left join song as c on b.song_id = c.song_id where a.rank_id=#{rankId}
select singer_id,singer_name from singer where category_id=#{categoryId} and singer_status=1
select song_id,song.song_name from song where singer_id=#{singerId} and song_status=1

select r.rs_id,r.ranking,r.rank_update_time,r.song_id,p.rank_id,p.rank_name,p.publish_time, s.song_name,si.singer_name from (select l.rank_id as love_rank_id ,l.user_id ,l.love_id,pe.rank_id,pe.rank_name,pe.publish_time, u.username from love_record as l left join personal_rank as pe on l.rank_id = pe.rank_id left join user as u on u.user_id=l.user_id where l.user_id=#{userId} order by pe.publish_time limit #{pageSize} offset #{offset}) as p left join rank_song as r on r.rank_id=p.rank_id left join song as s on r.song_id = s.song_id left join singer as si on s.singer_id = si.singer_id order by r.rank_update_time asc,r.ranking asc
select username from user where user_id=#{userId}

select c.com_id,c.rank_id,c.user_id,c.parent_id,c.comment_content,c.comment_time, ifnull(cl.like_count,0) as like_count,u.username,pu.username, case when cl2.user_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as is_liked from comment as c left join (select com_id,count(*) as like_count from like_comment as l group by com_id) as cl on cl.com_id=c.com_id left join like_comment cl2 on cl2.com_id=c.com_id and c.user_id=#{usesrId} left join personal_rank p on p.rank_id=c.rank_id left join user as u on u.user_id=c.user_id left join comment pc on pc.parent_id=c.user_id left join user pu on pc.user_id=pu.user_id where c.rank_id=#{rankId} and c.id_delete=0 order by c.comment_time asc limit 50
